# ascii/ui components, in full

> Every component of ascii/ui: when to use it and when not, its anatomy, states, keys, accessibility, API and the HTML to paste. Written by qa/reference.py from the site itself, so it says what the Code and Usage tabs say. The one-page map is https://ascii.fedekotek.design/llms.txt.

Install: link the two kit files, then paste the html of a component. It has no ids; the kit makes the ones accessibility needs, so the same html pasted twice is two working copies.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.css">
<script defer src="https://ascii.fedekotek.design/kit/ascii-ui.js"></script>
```

## Form

<a id="s-button"></a>
### Button

- Id: `s-button`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/button`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#button`
- Caption: The rim says how loud it is: @ for primary, = for the rest, / for danger. The last one is disabled: a faint rim and a gray label.
- Behaviors: none, HTML and CSS only
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
- Use it for:
  - One action a person takes on purpose: save, send, publish, open a dialog.
  - Primary, the @ rim, for the one thing the screen is for. One per screen. Two is a tie.
  - Danger, the / rim, for the action you cannot take back.
- Not for:
  - Going to another page. That is a link, `<a href>`, and the kit already styles it.
  - Picking one of a few options. That is a [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup).
  - Turning a setting on and off. That is the switch in [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles).

Anatomy:

```text
1 @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
  @@ PUBLISH SITE @@
1 @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
  ^^ ^^^^^^^^^^^^
  2  3
```

1. **frame** `.frame`: Top and bottom. The tone class names the character: `tone-heavy` @, `tone-light` =, `tone-danger` /.
2. **sides** `.mid`: The same character, two to a side.
3. **label** `.label`: The words, one line. A magenta slab on the primary. Uppercase is CSS: write them in sentence case.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `========` | The rim by tone: = here, @ on the primary, / on danger. |
| hover | `########` | One step denser, # here and % on the primary. Danger fills its label yellow. Mouse only. |
| focus | `@@@@@@@@` | Heavy rim in the focus color, from the keyboard. |
| pressed | ` PREVIEW` | An ink slab while it is held down. |
| disabled | `- - - -` | Faint rim, gray label, out of the Tab order. |
| no script | `========` | Still a button. The `data-aui-*` attributes need the script. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Moves the focus to it. Shift Tab goes back. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Presses it. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: A native `<button>`. Nothing to add.
- **name**: Its label. A button with only a glyph needs an `aria-label`.
- **state**: `disabled` takes it out of the Tab order and says so. The kit styles `:disabled`, not `aria-disabled`.
- **paint**: The rim is CSS content with empty alt text. Screen readers skip it.
- **touch**: Three rows tall, 63px. A thumb finds it.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Say what it does, as a verb and a thing: "Publish site". | Write "OK" or "Submit" and make people read the page to find out what they agreed to. |
| One primary per screen, for the thing the screen is for. | Make every button primary, so none of them is. |
| Put Danger on the one action that cannot be undone. | Paint Cancel yellow because it sounds negative. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.btn` | On the `<button>`. Uppercase, one line, no border of its own. |
| class | `.frame .tone-*` | The rim. `tone-heavy`, `tone-light`, `tone-danger`, or any other tone. |
| class | `.btn-primary` | Magenta rim, magenta slab under the label. With `tone-heavy`. |
| class | `.btn-danger` | Yellow rim and label. With `tone-danger`. |
| attr | `type="button"` | So it does not send the form it sits in. Only the one that sends leaves it out. |
| attr | `disabled` | Gray and faint, out of the Tab order. |
| attr | `data-aui-toast data-aui-toast-err` | A lime toast on click, or a yellow one. The words are the value. See [Toast](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toast). |
| attr | `data-aui-open data-aui-close` | Opens the dialog after it, or closes the one it sits in. See [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card). |
| attr | `data-aui-reset` | Puts the fields of its form or dialog back. See [Sheet](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/sheet). |
| attr | `data-aui-fill` | Runs the nearest progress bar, for demos. See [Progress](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/progress). |
| event | `click` | The native one. The kit adds none. |
| css | `--frame-color` | The rim color. The primary sets it to `--hot`, danger to `--danger`. |

See also: [Toast](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toast), [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card), [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown), [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup)

Limits:
- No icon slot and no loading state. `data-aui-fill` shows how a wait looks: a spinner in the label.
- On this site the label scrambles when it arrives and the rim draws itself. The kit button holds still.

```html
<div class="row">
  <button class="btn btn-primary frame tone-heavy" type="button"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Publish site</span></span></button>
  <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Preview</span></span></button>
  <button class="btn btn-danger frame tone-danger" type="button"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Discard draft</span></span></button>
  <button class="btn btn-primary frame tone-heavy" type="button" disabled><span class="mid"><span class="label">Publish site</span></span></button>
</div>
```

<a id="s-calendar"></a>
### Calendar

- Id: `s-calendar`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/calendar`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#calendar`
- Caption: A month of buttons. Today is the action color, your pick is a slab.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="calendar"`: draws the month, arrows and Page Up and Down move, the status line says the pick
- CSS blocks:
  - `ibtn`: `.ibtn`
  - `calendar`: `.cal`
- Use it for:
  - One day, picked from a month you can see: a delivery date, a booking, a deadline.
  - Days with limits. `data-min` and `data-max` gray out the rest and the arrows stop at the edge.
- Not for:
  - A date a person already knows, like a birthday. Typing is faster: an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) with `type="date"`.
  - A range, from and to. It picks one day.
  - A time of day. It has no hours.

Anatomy:

```text
1 [<]    SEPTEMBER 2026    [>]
2  M   T   W   T   F   S   S
3  21  22  23  24  25  26  27
               ^^      ^^^^
               4       5
6 Saturday, 26 September 2026.
```

1. **head** `.cal-head`: The month and the year, with [&lt;] and [&gt;] for the month before and after. They turn `disabled` past `data-min` or `data-max`.
2. **weekdays** `.cal-grid span`: One letter a day, in the language of the page. `aria-hidden`: every day says its own weekday.
3. **day** `.cal-grid button`: A real button, 4 characters wide. Its `aria-label` is the whole date.
4. **today** `.today`: Magenta and bold. The kit reads the date once, when it wires the calendar.
5. **picked** `[aria-pressed="true"]`: An ink slab with the edge, and `aria-pressed="true"`.
6. **status** `[role="status"]`: The nearest one says the pick in full, or "No date picked."

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| day | `  21` | A number in ink. |
| today | `  24` | Magenta and bold. |
| picked | `  26` | An ink slab with the edge. |
| focus | `  25` | A slab in the focus color. Only this day is in the Tab order. |
| disabled | `  19` | Outside `data-min` or `data-max`: gray, thin and `disabled`. |
| no script | ` ` | Nothing is drawn. Put an `<input type="date">` inside as a fallback: the script replaces it. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Through [&lt;] and [&gt;], then onto the focused day. The month is one Tab stop. |
| `Left`, `Right` | The day before or after, into the next month when it has to. |
| `Up`, `Down` | The same weekday, a week before or after. |
| `Home`, `End` | The first or the last day of the week. |
| `Page Up`, `Page Down` | The same day a month before or after, or the last day of a shorter month. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Picks the focused day. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: Buttons in a grid of boxes. It is not a `role="grid"`: a screen reader hears a run of buttons, each with its full date.
- **name**: Each day is named "Saturday, 26 September", in the language of the page. [&lt;] and [&gt;] are "Previous month" and "Next month".
- **state**: `aria-pressed="true"` on the pick. Days outside the limits are `disabled`.
- **live**: The status line is `role="status"`: it reads the pick when it changes. A new month is not announced; the day names carry it.
- **touch**: A day is 4 characters wide and 45px tall.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Set `data-min` and `data-max` when only some days make sense. | Let people pick a delivery date in the past and say no afterwards. |
| Say the pick in words, in the status line. | Leave the slab to say it alone. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="calendar"` | On an empty element. The kit draws the month into it. |
| attr | `data-value="2026-09-26"` | The day picked on load, as `yyyy-mm-dd`. Without it nothing is picked and today has the focus. |
| attr | `data-min data-max` | The first and the last day that can be picked, as `yyyy-mm-dd`. |
| attr | `data-week-start="0"` | Sunday first. Monday, 1, when missing. |
| attr | `data-locale="de"` | The language of the month and day names. The page's `lang` when missing. |
| attr | `data-name="when"` | Adds a hidden input with that name and the ISO date, for the form. Empty until a person picks. |
| class | `.cal .cal-head .cal-grid .today` | The box, the head, the grid, and today. |
| event | `aui:change` | On the calendar, when a person picks a day. `detail`: `{ date, value }`. `value` is `yyyy-mm-dd`. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.calendar(el)` | `set(date)` takes a `Date` or `"2026-09-26"`, `null` clears it. `date` and `value` say the pick. |

See also: [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input), [Pagination](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/pagination), [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup)

Limits:
- One day. No ranges, no times.
- No typing a date into it. The arrows and the month buttons are the way around.
- A reset of its form, or of the dialog it sits in, puts back `data-value`, or nothing picked.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="cal" data-aui="calendar"></div>
  <p class="muted status" role="status"></p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-input"></a>
### Input

- Id: `s-input`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/input`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#input`
- Caption: Focus turns the frame to @ in the focus color. An error turns it into a wall of !.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="validate"`: checks as you type, on leaving the field and on submit, writes the error
- CSS blocks:
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
- Use it for:
  - One line a person types: a name, a link, an email address.
  - A value with rules. `data-aui="validate"` checks them as you type and says what is wrong, under the field.
- Not for:
  - More than one line. That is a [Textarea](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/textarea).
  - Picking from a list you already know. That is a [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select).
  - A one-time code. That is [Input OTP](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/otp): six boxes, paste included.

Anatomy:

```text
1 Link
2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  !! > Reporting redesign !!
2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
     ^ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
     3 4
5 Use lowercase letters,
  numbers and hyphens.
```

1. **label** `.field-label`: A real `<label>`. The kit points its `for` at the input.
2. **frame** `.field`: With `.frame .tone-light`. = at rest, @ in the focus color, ! when wrong, as here. A tap anywhere on it focuses the input.
3. **prompt** `.prompt`: Paint, `aria-hidden`. &gt; for text; [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select) uses v.
4. **input** `input`: The real one. Its own rules say what is wrong: `required`, `pattern`, `type`, the lengths, the range.
5. **error** `.error`: Empty until something is wrong, and hidden while empty. The kit writes the words.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `========` | = rim, :: sides. |
| focus | `@@@@@@@@` | Heavy rim in the focus color. |
| invalid | `!!!!!!!!` | A wall of ! in yellow and the message under it. `.invalid` on the frame, `aria-invalid` on the input. |
| invalid, focused | `!!!!!!!!` | Stays yellow in kit 1.1.1: the caret is the only sign of focus. The site turns it blue. |
| disabled | `========` | Looks like rest in the kit. It only stops taking the focus. |
| no script | `========` | A plain field. The browser checks it on send, with its own bubble. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Moves the focus in. Leaving checks the value. |
| `Enter` | Sends its form, the browser way. A wrong field stops the send and gets the focus. |

Accessibility:
- **name**: The `<label>`. The kit links it with `for` when the label is not wrapped around the input.
- **state**: `aria-invalid` is `true` or `false`. The kit sets it as the verdict changes.
- **live**: The message is linked by `aria-describedby`. It is not announced as you type: it is read with the field, and a failed send moves the focus there.
- **paint**: The frame is paint. The prompt is `aria-hidden`.
- **touch**: The whole frame takes the tap, all three rows. Give it the right `type` and `autocomplete`: the phone picks its keyboard from them.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep the label above the field, where it stays while you type. | Use the placeholder as the label. It is gone after the first key. |
| Say what is wrong and how to fix it: "Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens." | Say "Invalid input" and leave the rest as an exercise. |
| Size the field to the answer: a postcode is short. | Stretch every field to the full width of the page. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.field .frame .tone-light` | The frame, around a `.mid` that holds the prompt and the input. |
| class | `.field-label .error` | The label above it and the message under it. |
| class | `.group` | Around label, field and message. 48 characters wide at most, a row between two. |
| attr | `data-aui="validate"` | On the `<input>`. Checks as you type, when you leave and when the form is sent. Writes to the nearest `.error`, or to what `aria-describedby` names. |
| attr | `required pattern type` | The rules, native. `minlength`, `maxlength`, `min` and `max` too. |
| attr | `data-error-required` | The words for a rule: also `data-error-type`, `data-error-pattern`, `data-error-length`, `data-error-range`, and `data-error` for the rest. A plain default when missing. |
| event | `aui:invalid aui:valid` | On the input, when a person changes the verdict. `detail`: `{ message, validity }`. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.validate(form)` | Checks every field in it, writes the messages, returns `true` or `false`. It moves no focus and fires no events. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(input)` | `check()`, `clear()`, `message`. |
| css | `--frame-color` | The rim color. Focus sets `--accent`, `.invalid` sets `--danger`. |

See also: [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select), [Textarea](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/textarea), [Input OTP](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/otp), [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles)

Limits:
- A wrong field that has the focus keeps its yellow rim in kit 1.1.1. Add `.field.invalid:focus-within{--frame-color:var(--accent)}` after the kit, as the site does.
- The kit gives a disabled field no look of its own. The site uses `.field:has(:disabled)`: a faint rim and gray text.
- On this site the rim ripples as you type and a wrong value buzzes. The kit is quiet.

```html
<div>
  <div class="group">
    <label class="field-label">Project title</label>
    <div class="field frame tone-light">
      <div class="mid">
        <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span>
        <input type="text" value="Reporting redesign" autocomplete="off">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="group">
    <label class="field-label">Link</label>
    <div class="field frame tone-light invalid">
      <div class="mid">
        <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span>
        <input type="text" value="Reporting redesign" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" aria-invalid="true" data-aui="validate" required pattern="[a-z0-9\-]+" data-error-required="Enter a link for this project." data-error-pattern="Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.">
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="error">Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a id="s-otp"></a>
### Input OTP

- Id: `s-otp`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/otp`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#otp`
- Caption: Six brackets. They advance on their own and take a paste.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="otp"`: advances, goes back on Backspace, takes a paste
- CSS blocks:
  - `otp`: `.otp`
- Use it for:
  - A one-time code sent by text or email: six digits, typed or pasted.
  - Sign-in and confirm steps. The first box has `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, so a phone offers the code from the message.
- Not for:
  - A password or anything a person chose. That is an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) with `type="password"`.
  - Codes with letters in them. The kit drops everything that is not a digit. Use an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input).
  - A number that is not a code, like a phone number. That is an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) with `type="tel"`.

Anatomy:

```text
1 [4] [2] [0] [_] [_] [_]
   ^           ^
   2           3
4 3 of 6.
```

1. **group** `.otp`: `role="group"` with an `aria-label`, where `data-aui="otp"` goes. One box per digit, in order.
2. **box** `.otp span`: A real `<input maxlength="1">` in a `<span>`. The brackets are the span's paint. They turn to the focus color around the box you are in.
3. **empty** `input[placeholder]`: The placeholder, `_`, in muted.
4. **status** `[role="status"]`: The nearest one says how many digits are in, then "Code 420123 accepted."

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| empty | `[_] [_]` | Brackets and underscores in muted. |
| focus | `[_]` | The brackets of the box you are in, in the focus color. |
| accepted | `[4] [2]` | Every box holds a digit: `.good` on the group, lime brackets and digits. |
| no script | `[_] [_]` | Six plain boxes. No advance, no paste across them, no hidden input. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab`, `Shift Tab` | Box to box, like any fields. A digit typed moves on by itself. |
| `Backspace` | In an empty box: clears the one before and goes there. |
| `Left`, `Right` | The box before or after. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `role="group"` with an `aria-label` holds the boxes. Each box has its own label, "Digit 1" to "Digit 6".
- **focus**: A box selects its digit when it gets the focus, so a new digit replaces it.
- **live**: The status line is `role="status"`. It says "3 of 6." as you type and the code once it is in.
- **touch**: `inputmode="numeric"` opens the number pad. The kit adds it when it is missing. Each box takes the tap 12px above and below.
- **paint**: The brackets are CSS content with empty alt text.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Say where the code was sent, above the boxes. | Leave a person to guess which inbox to open. |
| Let a paste fill every box. The kit does it already. | Block paste to feel secure. It only makes it slower. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="otp"` | On the `.otp`. Moves on after a digit, goes back on Backspace, spreads a paste over the boxes. |
| attr | `data-name="code"` | Adds a hidden input with that name and the whole code, for the form. |
| attr | `autocomplete="one-time-code"` | On the first box. The kit sets it when it is missing or `off`. |
| class | `.otp .good` | The group, and `.good` once every box holds a digit. |
| event | `aui:complete` | On the `.otp`, when a person fills the last box. `detail`: `{ value }`. Not on load, not for `value =`. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.otp(el)` | `value` reads the code or sets it, `clear()` empties every box. |

See also: [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input), [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button)

Limits:
- Digits only. Anything else is dropped as it is typed or pasted.
- The length is the number of boxes. Four boxes, four digits.
- No error look and no resend timer. Say a wrong code in the status line.
- On this site an accepted code plays a sound. The kit is quiet.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="otp" role="group" aria-label="One-time code" data-aui="otp">
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 1" autocomplete="one-time-code"></span>
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 2" autocomplete="off"></span>
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 3" autocomplete="off"></span>
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 4" autocomplete="off"></span>
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 5" autocomplete="off"></span>
    <span><input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" placeholder="_" aria-label="Digit 6" autocomplete="off"></span>
  </div>
  <p class="muted status" role="status">Type any six digits.</p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-select"></a>
### Select

- Id: `s-select`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/select`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#select`
- Caption: A native select inside the same frame as the input.
- Behaviors: none, HTML and CSS only
- CSS blocks:
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
- Use it for:
  - One value from a list a person already knows, five to fifteen of them: a region, a country, a size.
  - A value for a form. It is sent with it, and a phone shows its own picker.
- Not for:
  - Two to five options that fit on screen. That is a [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup): every choice in view, one tap.
  - Actions. That is a [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown).
  - A long list people search, like every city. The native list has no filter. Use an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) with a `<datalist>`.

Anatomy:

```text
1 Probe region
2 ============================
  :: v iad-1, Washington    ::
2 ============================
     ^ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
     3 4
```

1. **label** `.field-label`: A real `<label>`. The kit points its `for` at the select.
2. **frame** `.field`: The frame of the [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input): = at rest, @ in the focus color while the select has the focus.
3. **prompt** `.prompt`: A v, `aria-hidden`. It says a list opens here.
4. **select** `select`: The native one. The list is the browser's own, and so is the picker on a phone.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `========` | = rim, :: sides. |
| focus | `@@@@@@@@` | Heavy rim in the focus color. |
| invalid | `!!!!!!!!` | A wall of ! when the frame has `.invalid`. Nothing sets it for a select: add it yourself. |
| disabled | `========` | Looks like rest in the kit. The select stops taking the focus. |
| no script | `========` | Works as it is. It is native. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Moves the focus to it. |
| `Space` | Opens the list. From there the keys are the browser's. |
| `Down`, `Up` | The next or the previous option. A letter jumps to the first option that starts with it. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: A native `<select>`. A screen reader says its name, its value and how many options there are.
- **name**: The `<label>`. The kit links it with `for`.
- **paint**: The frame is paint. The prompt is `aria-hidden`.
- **touch**: The select fills the middle row. A tap on the rim above or below it does nothing: the kit focuses inputs and textareas from their frame, not selects.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Write options the way people say them: "fra-1, Frankfurt". | List bare internal codes and make people decode them. |
| Start with a first option that asks, when no default is right. | Preselect something nobody chose and send it. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.field .frame .tone-light` | The frame, around a `.mid` that holds the prompt and the select. |
| class | `.field-label .prompt` | The label above it and the v in front. |
| class | `.group` | Around label and field. 48 characters wide at most. |
| attr | `required` | Native. The browser checks it when the form is sent. |
| event | `change` | The select's own. The kit adds none. |
| css | `--frame-color` | The rim color. Focus sets `--accent`. |

See also: [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input), [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup), [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown)

Limits:
- `multiple` is not styled. The frame is one row tall.
- No search in the list. Past twenty options, people scroll.
- The rim above and below does not take the tap.

```html
<div class="group">
  <label class="field-label">Probe region</label>
  <div class="field frame tone-light">
    <div class="mid">
      <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">v</span>
      <select><option>iad-1, Washington</option><option>fra-1, Frankfurt</option><option>gru-1, Sao Paulo</option><option>sin-1, Singapore</option><option>syd-1, Sydney</option></select>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a id="s-slider"></a>
### Slider

- Id: `s-slider`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/slider`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#slider`
- Caption: Pick a value on a range. A real range input sits on top of the halftone bar. This one sets the page's glitch.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="slider"`: draws the bar from the range and fills the output
- CSS blocks:
  - `bar`: `.bar .slider .slider-track .progress`
- Use it for:
  - An amount where about right is right: volume, zoom, the glitch on this page.
  - A value whose effect shows while you drag.
- Not for:
  - An exact number. Type it: an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) with `type="number"`.
  - A few named choices, like low, medium and high. That is a [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup).
  - Showing how far along something is. That is [Progress](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/progress): the same bar, and nobody drags it.

Anatomy:

```text
1 Glitch amount
  @@@@@@@%#*+=:...........  55
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  ^^
  2+3                       4
```

1. **label** `.slider label`: A real `<label>`. The kit points its `for` at the range.
2. **bar** `.bar`: Paint, `aria-hidden`. 24 cells, `data-cells` sets how many. Magenta where it is full, dots where it is not.
3. **range** `input[type="range"]`: The real control, invisible, on top of the bar and 12px taller on each side, so a thumb finds it.
4. **output** `output`: The number. The kit fills it and points its `for` at the range.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `@%#*+=:.` | The bar, full to the value. Magenta, pink, yellow, then dots. |
| focus | `@%#*+=:.` | The whole bar turns to the focus color. |
| disabled | `@%#*+=:.` | No look of its own in the kit. The range stops moving; the bar does not say so. |
| no script | ` ` | The range still works, but it is invisible over an empty bar. Draw a bar into the HTML if the page has to work without the script. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Left`, `Down` | One step down. The step is the `step` attribute. |
| `Right`, `Up` | One step up. |
| `Page Down`, `Page Up` | A bigger step. Chrome takes a tenth of the range. |
| `Home`, `End` | The lowest, the highest. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: A native range: role `slider`, with its value and bounds from `min`, `max` and `value`. Every key above is the browser's own.
- **name**: The `<label>`. The kit links it with `for`.
- **state**: A bare number is read as a bare number. When it has a unit, set `aria-valuetext` from your `input` listener: "70 kg" beats "70".
- **live**: Chrome exposes the `<output>` as a polite live region, on top of the range's own value. If the number is read twice, give the output `aria-hidden="true"`.
- **paint**: The bar is `aria-hidden` paint.
- **touch**: The range covers the bar and 12px above and below it: 45px to aim at. `inputmode="none"` keeps some Android phones from opening a keyboard for it.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Show the number next to the bar, with its unit. | Make people drag to find out where they are. |
| Apply the value while it moves, when that is cheap. | Send a request on every step of a drag. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="slider"` | On the `.slider`. Draws the bar from the range and fills the `<output>`. |
| attr | `data-cells="24"` | How many cells the bar has. 24 when missing. Followed live. |
| attr | `min max step value` | On the range, native. `max` is 100 when missing. |
| class | `.slider .slider-track .bar` | The box, the track that holds the bar and the range, and the bar. |
| event | `input change` | The range's own. `input` while it moves, `change` when it is let go. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(el).draw()` | Redraws the bar after a script sets `value`. Setting `value` fires no event, so nothing redraws by itself. |

See also: [Progress](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/progress), [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input), [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup)

Limits:
- One thumb. For a range with two ends, use two sliders.
- On this site the bar jitters while you drag and the slider sets the glitch of the whole page. The kit draws a clean bar and leaves the meaning to you.

```html
<div class="slider" data-aui="slider">
  <label>Glitch amount</label>
  <span class="slider-track"><span class="bar" aria-hidden="true"></span><input type="range" inputmode="none" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="55"></span>
  <output>55</output>
</div>
```

<a id="s-textarea"></a>
### Textarea

- Id: `s-textarea`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/textarea`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#textarea`
- Caption: The same frame, four rows tall, with a counter.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="counter"`: counts against maxlength
- CSS blocks:
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
- Use it for:
  - More than one line: a note, a description, a message.
  - Text with a limit. The count under it says how far along you are.
- Not for:
  - One line. That is an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input): Enter sends the form.
  - Rich text. This is plain text: no bold, no links.
  - A code or a number. That is [Input OTP](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/otp) or an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input).

Anatomy:

```text
1 Crit notes
2 ============================
3 ::  What is this screen   ::
  ::  trying to do?         ::
2 ============================
4                       12/280
```

1. **label** `.field-label`: A real `<label>`. The kit points its `for` at the textarea.
2. **frame** `.field.area`: The frame with `.area`: walls of : down each side, as tall as the textarea.
3. **textarea** `textarea`: The real one, with `rows` and `maxlength`. It does not resize.
4. **count** `.count`: Written by the kit: characters typed, a slash, the `maxlength`. Yellow and bold once it is full.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `========` | = rim, :: walls. |
| focus | `@@@@@@@@` | Heavy rim in the focus color. |
| full | `280/280` | `.full` on the count at `maxlength`. The browser stops taking characters. |
| invalid | `!!!!!!!!` | A wall of ! when the frame has `.invalid`. The counter never sets it. |
| no script | `========` | A plain textarea. The count stays at what the HTML says. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Moves the focus in, and out again. It never types a tab. |
| `Enter` | A new line. It does not send the form. |

Accessibility:
- **name**: The `<label>`. The kit links it with `for`.
- **state**: The count is plain text after the field: not linked, not announced. Point `aria-describedby` at it when people need it read with the field.
- **paint**: The frame is paint.
- **touch**: The whole frame takes the tap, walls included.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Give it as many `rows` as a good answer needs. | Ask for a paragraph through a two-row slot. |
| Set `maxlength` only when the limit is real. | Count against a number nobody enforces. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="counter"` | On the `<textarea>`. Counts against `maxlength` into the nearest `.count`. |
| attr | `maxlength` | Native. Without it the count is a plain number. |
| attr | `data-status="id"` | Names a count somewhere else on the page. |
| class | `.field .area` | The frame, with walls instead of sides. |
| class | `.count .full` | The count, and `.full` at the limit. |
| event | `input` | The textarea's own. The kit adds none. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(el).draw()` | Counts again after a script sets `value`. Setting `value` fires no event. |

See also: [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input), [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select)

Limits:
- No auto-grow. It stays `rows` tall and scrolls.
- The count only counts. It turns yellow at the limit, not before.

```html
<div class="group">
  <label class="field-label">Crit notes</label>
  <div class="field frame tone-light area">
    <div class="body">
      <textarea rows="4" maxlength="280" placeholder="What is this screen trying to do?" data-aui="counter"></textarea>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="count">0/280</p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-togglegroup"></a>
### Toggle group

- Id: `s-togglegroup`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/togglegroup`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#togglegroup`
- Caption: Pick one of a few options. Radios dressed as slabs.
- Behaviors: none, HTML and CSS only
- CSS blocks:
  - `segment`: `.tgroup`
- Use it for:
  - One of two to five short options, all in view: a view, a period, a size.
  - A setting that applies as soon as it is picked, or a value for a form. They are radios, so the form sends them.
- Not for:
  - Swapping panels of content. That is [Tabs](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/tabs).
  - More options than fit on one line. That is a [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select).
  - On and off. That is the switch in [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles).

Anatomy:

```text
1   LIST    BOARD    CALENDAR
    ^^^^    ^^^^^
    2       3
```

1. **group** `.tgroup`: `role="radiogroup"` with an `aria-label`. One row; it wraps on a narrow screen.
2. **option** `.tgroup span`: A `<label>` around an invisible radio and a `<span>`. The span is what you see, a muted word.
3. **picked** `input:checked + span`: The checked radio's span: an ink slab with the edge.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `  LIST` | A muted word. |
| checked | ` BOARD` | An ink slab with the edge. |
| focus | `  LIST` | A slab in the focus color, from the keyboard. The arrows pick as they go. |
| no script | `  LIST` | Works as it is. They are radios. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Lands on the checked option. The group is one Tab stop. |
| `Left`, `Right` | Picks the option before or after, and wraps. The browser does it: they are radios. |
| `Space` | Picks the focused option when none is picked. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `role="radiogroup"` around native radios. A screen reader says "radio button, 2 of 3".
- **name**: Give the radiogroup an `aria-label`, or put it in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`.
- **state**: Checked is the radio's own. Nothing to keep in step.
- **live**: The status line after it is `role="status"`, and the kit does not write to it. Write the new value there from a `change` listener, or leave it out.
- **touch**: Each option is 45px tall with its padding.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep each label to a word or two, so the row fits a phone. | Put a sentence on a slab. |
| Check one option in the HTML. | Leave all of them unchecked. It reads as broken, not as a choice. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.tgroup` | On the `role="radiogroup"`. Each option is a `<label>` with an `<input type="radio">` and a `<span>`. |
| attr | `name` | One `name` per group. Pasted twice, the kit renames the second copy so the two do not fight. |
| attr | `checked` | The option picked on load. |
| event | `change` | The radio's own. The kit adds none. |

See also: [Tabs](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/tabs), [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles), [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select)

Limits:
- The kit does not write the status line. On this site a script does.
- One pick. For several, use checkboxes: [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles).

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div>
    <div class="tgroup" role="radiogroup" aria-label="View">
      <label><input type="radio" name="viewmode" value="list"><span>List</span></label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="viewmode" value="board" checked><span>Board</span></label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="viewmode" value="cal"><span>Calendar</span></label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="muted status" role="status">Board view.</p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-toggles"></a>
### Toggles

- Id: `s-toggles`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/toggles`
- Group: Form
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#toggles`
- Caption: Checkbox, radio and switch. Native inputs, the glyph is only the paint.
- Behaviors: none, HTML and CSS only
- CSS blocks:
  - `check`: `.check .switch-track`
- Use it for:
  - Checkbox: a yes or no a person can change, alone or in a list. "Include archived projects".
  - Radio: one of a few, in a `<fieldset>` whose `<legend>` asks the question.
  - Switch: a setting that applies the moment it flips. Autoplay, sound.
- Not for:
  - A choice that waits for a Save button. That is a checkbox, not a switch.
  - Two to five short options in a row. That is a [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup).
  - An action. That is a [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button).

Anatomy:

```text
1 [@] Show on home page
  [ ] Include archived projects
2 (@) Public
3 [..@@] Autoplay motion
  ^^^
  4
```

1. **label** `.check`: A `<label>` around the input, the glyph and the words. The whole row takes the tap.
2. **radio** `input[type="radio"]`: ( ) and (@). One `name` per group, in a `<fieldset>`.
3. **switch** `[role="switch"]`: A checkbox with `role="switch"` and a `.switch-track` in its glyph. The @@ moves right when it is on.
4. **glyph** `.glyph`: Paint, `aria-hidden`: [ ] and [@], lime when checked. The real input is invisible, under it.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| rest | `[ ] ( )` | Brackets and parentheses in ink. |
| checked | `[@] (@)` | Lime, with @ inside. |
| focus | `[ ]` | The glyph turns into a slab in the focus color. |
| switch off | `[@@..]` | @@ at the left, dots after. |
| switch on | `[..@@]` | @@ at the right, in lime. |
| no script | `[ ] ( )` | Works as it is. They are native inputs. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | To each checkbox and switch. A radio group is one Tab stop. |
| `Space` | Checks or unchecks a checkbox or a switch. On a radio, picks it. |
| `Down`, `Up` | Between the radios of a group, picking as they go. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: Native checkbox and radio. `role="switch"` makes a checkbox read as on or off.
- **name**: The words in the label. A radio group gets its question from the `<legend>`.
- **state**: Checked is native. Nothing to keep in step.
- **paint**: The glyph is `aria-hidden` and its brackets are CSS content.
- **touch**: The label is the target, 12px above and below the row: 45px tall, as wide as the words.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Label the checked state: "Show on home page". | Ask "Hide from home page?" and hand people a double negative. |
| Put radios in a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`. | Leave a lone radio. Once checked, it cannot be unchecked. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.check` | The `<label>`. The input goes first, then `<span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true">`, then the words. |
| class | `.glyph .switch-track` | The paint. A switch holds `[<span class="switch-track"></span>]` in its glyph. |
| attr | `role="switch"` | On a checkbox: the switch. |
| attr | `checked name` | Native. `name` groups radios; pasted twice, the kit renames the second group. |
| event | `change` | The input's own. The kit adds none. |

See also: [Toggle group](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/togglegroup), [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select), [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button)

Limits:
- No look for `indeterminate`. A screen reader says it, the glyph shows [ ].
- A switch is sent with the form as a checkbox: its value when on, nothing when off.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="stack">
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Show on home page</label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Include archived projects</label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" checked><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true">[<span class="switch-track"></span>]</span>Autoplay motion</label>
  </div>
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Visibility</legend>
    <div class="stack">
      <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="vis" checked><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Public</label>
      <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="vis"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Unlisted</label>
      <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="vis"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Private</label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
</div>
```

## Overlay

<a id="s-alertdialog"></a>
### Alert dialog

- Id: `s-alertdialog`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/alertdialog`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#alertdialog`
- Caption: A dialog that asks before something you cannot undo. A tap outside does not count as an answer.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="confirm"`: keeps the danger button off until the name is typed
  - `data-aui-open`: opens the dialog next to it
  - `data-aui-close`: closes its dialog or popover
  - `data-aui-toast-err`: shows a yellow toast
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `dialog`: `dialog`
  - `alert`: `.alert`
  - `alertdialog`: `[role="alertdialog"]`
- Usage: not written yet. The rows below are read from the kit.

Accessibility:
- **role**: `alertdialog`, in the markup. (from the kit)
- **kit**: Sets `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` itself. (from the kit)

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="confirm"` | Keeps the danger button off until the name is typed. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui-open` | Opens the dialog next to it. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui-close` | Closes its dialog or popover. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui-toast-err` | Shows a yellow toast. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-error="Type "` | Type  when missing. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-match` | Read by the kit. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(el)` | `check`, `ok`. (from the kit) |

See also: [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card), [Alert](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/alert) (from the kit)

```html
<div class="row">
  <div>
    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn btn-danger frame tone-danger" type="button" data-aui-open><span class="mid"><span class="label">Delete project</span></span></button>
    </div>
    <dialog role="alertdialog">
      <div class="alert lift">
        <div class="card frame tone-danger">
          <h2 class="bar-title">Delete project?</h2>
          <div class="body">
            <p>Reporting redesign and its 14 comments go for good. There is no undo.</p>
            <div class="row">
              <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" autofocus data-aui-close><span class="mid"><span class="label">Keep it</span></span></button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger frame tone-danger" type="button" data-aui-close="delete" data-aui-toast-err="Deleted. It is gone."><span class="mid"><span class="label">Delete</span></span></button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="row">
      <button class="btn btn-danger frame tone-danger" type="button" data-aui-open><span class="mid"><span class="label">Delete workspace</span></span></button>
    </div>
    <dialog role="alertdialog">
      <div class="alert lift">
        <div class="card frame tone-danger">
          <h2 class="bar-title">Delete static-prod?</h2>
          <div class="body">
            <p>Every monitor, status page and incident in static-prod goes. Type its name to confirm.</p>
            <div class="group">
              <label class="field-label">Workspace name</label>
              <div class="field frame tone-light">
                <div class="mid">
                  <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span>
                  <input type="text" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" data-match="static-prod" autofocus data-aui="confirm">
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="error"></p>
            </div>
            <div class="row">
              <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" data-aui-close><span class="mid"><span class="label">Keep it</span></span></button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger frame tone-danger" type="button" disabled data-aui-close="delete" data-aui-toast-err="Workspace deleted. Nothing to watch now."><span class="mid"><span class="label">Delete</span></span></button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a id="s-combobox"></a>
### Combobox

- Id: `s-combobox`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/combobox`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#combobox`
- Caption: Type and the list gets shorter. For when a Select would scroll forever.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="combobox"`: narrows the list as you type, arrows and Enter pick, says when nothing matches
- CSS blocks:
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `pane`: `.pane`
  - `combobox`: `.combo .opts`
- Usage: not written yet. The rows below are read from the kit.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| focus | ` ` | `.field:focus-within` (from the kit) |
| disabled | ` ` | `.field:has(:disabled)` (from the kit) |
| invalid | ` ` | `.field.invalid` (from the kit) |
| selected | ` ` | `.opts [role="option"][aria-selected="true"]` (from the kit) |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `combobox`, `listbox`, `option`, `status`, in the markup. (from the kit)
- **kit**: Sets `aria-describedby`, `aria-live`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-selected` itself. (from the kit)

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="combobox"` | Narrows the list as you type, arrows and Enter pick, says when nothing matches. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-empty="Nothing matches."` | Nothing matches. when missing. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-error-list="Pick one from the list."` | Pick one from the list. when missing. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-name data-label data-value data-active data-free` | Read by the kit. (from the kit) |
| event | `aui:change` | On the combobox element. `detail`: `{ value, label, option }`. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.combobox(el)` | `open`, `close`, `set`, `value`, `label`, `option`, `isOpen`. (from the kit) |

See also: [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card) (from the kit)

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="group">
    <label class="field-label">Probe region</label>
    <div class="combo" data-empty="No region by that name. Yet." data-error-list="Pick a region from the list." data-aui="combobox" data-name="region">
      <div class="field frame tone-light">
        <div class="mid">
          <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">v</span>
          <input type="text" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Type a city or a code">
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pane" hidden>
        <div class="lift">
          <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
            <div class="body">
              <div class="opts" role="listbox">
                <div role="option" data-value="iad-1">iad-1, Washington</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="ord-1">ord-1, Chicago</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="sfo-1">sfo-1, San Francisco</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="gru-1">gru-1, São Paulo</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="eze-1">eze-1, Buenos Aires</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="lhr-1">lhr-1, London</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="fra-1">fra-1, Frankfurt</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="arn-1">arn-1, Stockholm</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="jnb-1">jnb-1, Johannesburg</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="bom-1">bom-1, Mumbai</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="sin-1">sin-1, Singapore</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="hnd-1">hnd-1, Tokyo</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="syd-1">syd-1, Sydney</div>
                <div role="option" data-value="mcm-1" aria-disabled="true">mcm-1, McMurdo (full)</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="error"></p>
  </div>
  <p class="muted status" role="status"></p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-command"></a>
### Command

- Id: `s-command`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/command`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: no, site only
- Caption: The command menu. On this site it is Search: press / and type. Site only, not in the kit.
- Note: Site only, not in the kit. Search is this site's own palette. The kit has no command palette yet, so this is a button and a kbd.
- Behaviors: none, HTML and CSS only
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `kbd`: `kbd .kbds`
- Site only: Site only, not in the kit. Search is this site's own palette.
- Use it for:
  - Jumping anywhere on a big site or app by typing: a page, a setting, a command.
  - People who live on the keyboard. On this site / and Ctrl K open it.
- Not for:
  - The main navigation. Most people never press /. Keep the links on screen.
  - A handful of actions on one thing. That is a [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown).

Anatomy:

```text
  =================
1 :: OPEN SEARCH ::
  =================
2 or press [/]
```

1. **button** `.btn`: A [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button) that opens Search.
2. **key** `kbd`: A [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd): the shortcut, written out next to the way in.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| closed | `========` | The button and the key hint. |
| open | `@@@@@@@@` | A modal dialog: a search field, and the results under it in groups. |
| no match | `- - - -` | The list says so, and the field keeps what you typed. |
| no script | `========` | The button does nothing. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `/` | Opens it from anywhere but a text field. |
| `Ctrl K` | Opens it too, and closes it again. Cmd K on a Mac. |
| `Down`, `Up` | The next or the previous result. It wraps. |
| `Home`, `End` | The first or the last result. |
| `Page Down`, `Page Up` | The next or the previous group. |
| `Enter` | Goes to the result. |
| `Esc` | Clears the field. Pressed on an empty field, closes. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: The field is a `role="combobox"` that drives a `role="listbox"`. The focus stays in the field; `aria-activedescendant` says which result is picked.
- **name**: The dialog is named by its title, Search. The way in says its shortcuts with `aria-keyshortcuts`.
- **live**: How many results there are is said in a `role="status"` line as you type.
- **focus**: It opens with the focus in the field, and gives it back to what opened it.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Show the shortcut next to the way in, as here. | Hide the only way in behind a key. |
| Match the words people type, not only the titles. Here "modal" finds Card and dialog. | Match titles letter by letter. |

Made of: [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd)

See also: [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown), [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd), [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input)

Limits:
- Not in the kit. A palette of your own starts from an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input) and a list of links.

```html
<div class="row">
  <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Open search</span></span></button>
  <span class="muted">or press <kbd>/</kbd></span>
</div>
```

<a id="s-contextmenu"></a>
### Context menu

- Id: `s-contextmenu`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/contextmenu`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#contextmenu`
- Caption: The menu under the right mouse button. Press and hold on a phone, Shift F10 on a keyboard.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="contextmenu"`: opens on right-click, a long press or Shift F10, arrows and letters move, Escape closes
- CSS blocks:
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `badge`: `.badge`
  - `dropdown`: `.pop .menu`
  - `pane`: `.pane`
  - `contextmenu`: `.ctx`
  - `kbd`: `kbd .kbds`
  - `divider`: `.sepd .sepl`
  - `table`: `.tablewrap .tbl`
- Usage: not written yet. The rows below are read from the kit.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| focus | ` ` | `.tbl tbody tr:focus-visible` (from the kit) |
| selected | ` ` | `.tbl tbody tr[aria-selected="true"]` (from the kit) |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `ContextMenu`, `F10` | Handled by ascii-ui.js. (from the kit) |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `menu`, `menuitem`, `separator`, `status`, in the markup. (from the kit)
- **kit**: Sets `aria-hidden`, `aria-keyshortcuts` itself. (from the kit)

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="contextmenu"` | Opens on right-click, a long press or Shift F10, arrows and letters move, Escape closes. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-ctx` | Read by the kit. (from the kit) |
| event | `aui:select` | On the contextmenu element. `detail`: `{ item, text, target }`. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.contextmenu(el)` | `open`, `close`, `isOpen`, `target`. (from the kit) |

See also: [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card), [Badge](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/badge), [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown), [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd), [Separator](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/separator) (from the kit)

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="ctx" data-aui="contextmenu">
    <div class="tablewrap">
      <table class="tbl">
        <caption class="vh">Incidents. Right-click a row, or press Shift F10 on it, for what you can do with it.</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr><th scope="col">ID</th><th scope="col">Service</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr tabindex="0">
            <td>INC-481</td>
            <td>api-gateway</td>
            <td><span class="badge b-hot">Down</span></td>
          </tr>
          <tr tabindex="0">
            <td>INC-480</td>
            <td>checkout</td>
            <td><span class="badge b-warn">Degraded</span></td>
          </tr>
          <tr tabindex="0">
            <td>INC-479</td>
            <td>search</td>
            <td><span class="badge b-ok">Resolved</span></td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="menu pane" role="menu" aria-label="Incident" hidden>
      <div class="lift">
        <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
          <div class="body">
            <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1">Open <kbd>o</kbd></button>
            <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1">Copy ID <kbd>c</kbd></button>
            <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1">Assign to me <kbd>a</kbd></button>
            <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" disabled>Undo</button>
            <div class="sepd faint" role="separator"></div>
            <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" class="danger">Delete</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="muted status" role="status">Right-click a row, or press and hold it.</p>
</div>
```

<a id="s-dropdown"></a>
### Dropdown

- Id: `s-dropdown`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/dropdown`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#dropdown`
- Caption: A button that opens a menu. Arrows move, Escape closes.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="dropdown"`: opens the menu, arrows move, Escape and Tab close
  - `data-aui-toast`: shows a toast
  - `data-aui-toast-err`: shows a yellow toast
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `dropdown`: `.pop .menu`
  - `kbd`: `kbd .kbds`
  - `divider`: `.sepd .sepl`
  - `toast`: `.toast [data-aui-toast]`
- Use it for:
  - A handful of actions on one thing that do not need to be on screen all the time: duplicate, copy a link, archive.
  - Labels up to 18 characters, key hint included. The menu is 28 wide.
- Not for:
  - A value for a form. That is a [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select): it is sent with the form and a phone shows its own picker.
  - One or two actions. Show them as [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button)s. A menu hides them for nothing.
  - The navigation of a site. `role="menu"` tells a screen reader to expect an app. Use a list of links.

Anatomy:

```text
  ===============
1 :: ACTIONS V ::
  ===============
2 @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
  @@  Duplicate      [d]  @@::
3 @@  Copy link      [l]  @@::
4 @@  - - - - - - - - -   @@::
5 @@  Delete forever      @@::
  @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@::
    ::::::::::::::::::::::::::
```

1. **trigger** `[aria-haspopup]`: A [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button) with `aria-haspopup="menu"`. The kit keeps its `aria-expanded` true or false.
2. **menu** `.menu`: `role="menu"` around a card in `tone-heavy`. `hidden` until it opens, 28 characters wide, under the trigger.
3. **item** `[role="menuitem"]`: A real button with `tabindex="-1"`. The one with the focus is an ink slab. A `<kbd>` at the end is a label, nothing more.
4. **rule** `.sepd`: A [Separator](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/separator) with `role="separator"`, between groups of items.
5. **danger** `.danger`: Yellow words and a yellow slab under the focus. For the one you cannot take back.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| closed | `========` | The menu is `hidden` and the trigger says `aria-expanded="false"`. |
| open | `@@@@@@@@` | The card, under the trigger and over whatever is below it. |
| item focus, hover | `  Copy` | An ink slab, from the keyboard or the pointer. In a menu they are the same thing. |
| danger focus | ` Delete` | A yellow slab. |
| no script | `========` | The trigger does nothing and the menu stays closed. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Enter`, `Space` | On the trigger: opens the menu, the focus on the first item. On an item: picks it and closes. |
| `Down`, `Up` | On the trigger: opens, the focus on the first or the last item. In the menu: the next or the previous one. It wraps. |
| `Home`, `End` | The first or the last item. |
| `Esc` | Closes. The focus goes back to the trigger. |
| `Tab` | Closes, and the focus moves on. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `aria-haspopup="menu"` on the trigger, `role="menu"` on the list, `role="menuitem"` on each item. The kit adds `aria-controls` and keeps `aria-expanded`.
- **name**: Give the menu an `aria-label`. An item is named by all of its text: `Duplicate <kbd>d</kbd>` is read "Duplicate d". Put `aria-hidden` on the `<kbd>`: in the kit it is a label, not a key.
- **focus**: Opening moves the focus into the menu, closing puts it back on the trigger. Items stay out of the Tab order.
- **touch**: A tap anywhere outside closes it. Items are 45px tall.
- **paint**: The rims, walls and shadow are paint. The v after the label is `aria-hidden`.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Put the item you cannot take back last, after a rule, in yellow. | Put Delete next to Duplicate, where a slip of the thumb picks it. |
| Name items with verbs: Duplicate, Copy link, Archive. | Mix actions and settings in one menu. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="dropdown"` | On the `.pop`. The `[aria-haspopup]` button inside opens the `role="menu"` inside. |
| class | `.pop .menu` | The box around both, and the menu. `.danger` on an item makes it yellow. |
| attr | `disabled` | On an item: the arrows skip it. The kit gives it no look of its own. |
| attr | `data-aui-toast data-aui-toast-err` | On an item: a lime or a yellow toast when it is picked. |
| event | `aui:select` | On the `.pop`, when an item is picked. `detail`: `{ item, text }`. `text` is all of it, key hint included: "Duplicate d". |
| call | `ASCIIUI.dropdown(el)` | `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`, `isOpen`. `open()` leaves the focus where it is. |

See also: [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Select](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/select), [Tooltip](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/tooltip), [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd), [Separator](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/separator)

Limits:
- The letters next to the items are labels. On this site they pick the item; in the kit they do nothing.
- No typing to jump to an item, no submenus, no items that check on and off.
- It always opens under the trigger, from its left edge. Near the bottom or the right of the screen it does not flip.

```html
<div class="pop" data-aui="dropdown">
  <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Actions <span aria-hidden="true">v</span></span></span></button>
  <div class="menu" role="menu" aria-label="Actions" hidden>
    <div class="lift">
      <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
        <div class="body">
          <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" data-aui-toast="Duplicate.">Duplicate <kbd>d</kbd></button>
          <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" data-aui-toast="Copy link.">Copy link <kbd>l</kbd></button>
          <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" data-aui-toast="Move to archive.">Move to archive</button>
          <div class="sepd faint" role="separator"></div>
          <button role="menuitem" type="button" tabindex="-1" class="danger" data-aui-toast-err="Delete forever. It is gone.">Delete forever</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a id="s-popover"></a>
### Popover

- Id: `s-popover`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/popover`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#popover`
- Caption: A small panel next to its button, for things that do not deserve a dialog. Escape or a click outside puts it away.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="popover"`: opens the panel next to its button, Escape and a click outside close it, the focus comes back
  - `data-aui="validate"`: checks as you type, on leaving the field and on submit, writes the error
  - `data-aui-close`: closes its dialog or popover
  - `data-aui-toast`: shows a toast
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `field`: `.field .field-label .error .count`
  - `check`: `.check .switch-track`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `dropdown`: `.pop .menu`
  - `pane`: `.pane`
  - `popover`: `[data-aui="popover"]`
  - `toast`: `.toast [data-aui-toast]`
- Usage: not written yet. The rows below are read from the kit.

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Esc` | Handled by ascii-ui.js. (from the kit) |

Accessibility:
- **kit**: Sets `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` itself. (from the kit)

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="popover"` | Opens the panel next to its button, Escape and a click outside close it, the focus comes back. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui="validate"` | Checks as you type, on leaving the field and on submit, writes the error. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui-close` | Closes its dialog or popover. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-aui-toast` | Shows a toast. (from the kit) |
| attr | `data-error-required data-error-type data-error-pattern data-error-length data-error-range data-error` | Read by the kit. (from the kit) |
| event | `aui:toggle` | On the popover element. `detail`: `{ open }`. (from the kit) |
| event | `aui:invalid` | On the validate element. `detail`: `{ message, validity }`. (from the kit) |
| event | `aui:valid` | On the validate element. `detail`: `{ message, validity }`. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.popover(el)` | `open`, `close`, `toggle`, `isOpen`. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.validate(el, ...)` | A call of its own on `window.ASCIIUI`. (from the kit) |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(el)` | `check`, `clear`, `message`. (from the kit) |

See also: [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles), [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card) (from the kit)

```html
<div class="row">
  <div class="pop" data-aui="popover">
    <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Snooze <span aria-hidden="true">v</span></span></span></button>
    <div class="pane" hidden>
      <div class="lift">
        <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
          <h3 class="bar-title">Snooze api-gateway</h3>
          <div class="body">
            <fieldset>
              <legend class="vh">Snooze for</legend>
              <div class="stack">
                <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="snooze" value="15m"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>15 minutes</label>
                <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="snooze" value="1h" checked><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>1 hour</label>
                <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="snooze" value="tomorrow"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span>Until tomorrow, 09:00</label>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            <div class="row">
              <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" data-aui-close><span class="mid"><span class="label">Cancel</span></span></button>
              <button class="btn btn-primary frame tone-heavy" type="button" data-aui-close data-aui-toast="Snoozed. It will be back."><span class="mid"><span class="label">Snooze</span></span></button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pop" data-aui="popover">
    <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Rename</span></span></button>
    <div class="pane" hidden>
      <div class="lift">
        <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
          <h3 class="bar-title">Rename probe</h3>
          <form class="body" method="dialog">
            <div class="group">
              <label class="field-label">Name</label>
              <div class="field frame tone-light">
                <div class="mid">
                  <span class="prompt" aria-hidden="true">&gt;</span>
                  <input type="text" value="iad-1 checkout" autocomplete="off" required data-aui="validate" data-error-required="Enter a name for the probe.">
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="error"></p>
            </div>
            <div class="row">
              <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" data-aui-close><span class="mid"><span class="label">Cancel</span></span></button>
              <button class="btn btn-primary frame tone-heavy" type="submit"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Save</span></span></button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

<a id="s-sheet"></a>
### Sheet

- Id: `s-sheet`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/sheet`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#sheet`
- Caption: A dialog that comes up from the bottom in seven steps.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui-open`: opens the dialog next to it
  - `data-aui-close`: closes its dialog or popover
  - `data-aui-toast`: shows a toast
  - `data-aui-reset`: puts the fields of its form or dialog back
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `check`: `.check .switch-track`
  - `card`: `.card .lift .bar-title .body`
  - `dialog`: `dialog`
  - `sheet`: `.sheet`
  - `toast`: `.toast [data-aui-toast]`
- Use it for:
  - Filters, options or a short form on a phone, where a centered dialog would be cramped.
  - A task that belongs to the page under it and ends with Apply or the [x].
- Not for:
  - A decision the page has to stop for. That is the dialog in [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card): centered, one question.
  - Anything long enough to scroll twice. Give it a page.
  - Actions on one thing. That is a [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown).

Anatomy:

```text
                    2
                    v
1 @@ FILTERS @@@@@ [x] @@@@@@
  @@                       @@
3 @@  [@] Only my orders   @@
  @@  [ ] Overdue          @@
  @@                       @@
4 @@    RESET   APPLY      @@
  @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
```

1. **sheet** `dialog.sheet`: A native `<dialog>` with `.sheet`: full width, on the bottom edge, 82% of the screen tall at most. It comes up in seven steps.
2. **close** `.sheet-x`: [x] in the title row, with `data-aui-close` and an `aria-label` that says what it closes.
3. **body** `.body`: The card body. It scrolls by itself when there is more than fits; the page behind it does not move.
4. **reset** `[data-aui-reset]`: Puts every field in the sheet back to what the HTML says.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| closed | ` ` | Not drawn. The button is all there is. |
| open | `. . . .` | Up from the bottom in seven steps, over magenta dots. The page behind is inert and does not scroll. |
| reduced motion | `@@@@@@@@` | Up at once, no steps. |
| no script | `========` | The button does nothing and the sheet stays closed. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Enter`, `Space` | On the button: opens it. The focus goes to the field with `autofocus`, or the first one that takes it. |
| `Tab`, `Shift Tab` | Through the fields and buttons of the sheet. The page behind is out of reach. |
| `Esc` | Closes it. The focus goes back to the button that opened it. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: A native `<dialog>`, opened with `showModal()`: modal, the page behind is inert.
- **name**: The kit names it by its `.bar-title` with `aria-labelledby`.
- **focus**: On open, the `autofocus` field takes the focus: here the first checkbox. On close, the focus goes back to the opener.
- **live**: Apply closes the sheet first, then the toast shows on the page and is read out.
- **touch**: A tap on the dots closes it. The [x] is 45px tall.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| End it with one clear way out: Apply, and the [x]. | Stack three buttons that all close it. |
| Apply the filters when Apply is pressed. | Filter the page behind it on every tap, where nobody can see it happen. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| class | `.sheet .sheet-x` | On the `<dialog>`, and on its close button. The card inside is `tone-heavy`. |
| attr | `data-aui-open` | On a button. Opens the `<dialog>` after it, in the same element. `data-aui-open="id"` opens that one. |
| attr | `data-aui-close` | On a button in the sheet: closes it. |
| attr | `data-aui-reset` | On a button in the sheet: puts every field back, then redraws what depends on them. |
| attr | `data-aui-toast` | With `data-aui-close`: closes it, then says so. |
| event | `aui:reset` | On the `<dialog>`, after a reset put the fields back. `detail`: `{}`. |
| event | `close` | The dialog's own, however it closes. |

See also: [Card and dialog](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/card), [Toggles](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/toggles), [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown)

Limits:
- It does not drag. No handle and no swipe down: the [x], Escape or a tap on the dots.
- Reset puts back what the HTML says, not what was there when the sheet opened.

```html
<div>
  <div class="row">
    <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" data-aui-open><span class="mid"><span class="label">Open filters</span></span></button>
  </div>
  <dialog class="sheet">
    <div class="lift">
      <div class="card frame tone-heavy">
        <h2 class="bar-title">Filters</h2>
        <button class="sheet-x" type="button" aria-label="Close the filters" data-aui-close>[x]</button>
        <div class="body">
          <div class="stack">
            <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked autofocus><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Only my work orders</span></label>
            <label class="check"><input type="checkbox"><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Overdue</span></label>
            <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" checked><span class="glyph" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>High priority</span></label>
          </div>
          <div class="row">
            <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button" data-aui-reset><span class="mid"><span class="label">Reset</span></span></button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary frame tone-heavy" type="button" data-aui-close data-aui-toast="Filters applied."><span class="mid"><span class="label">Apply</span></span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</div>
```

<a id="s-tooltip"></a>
### Tooltip

- Id: `s-tooltip`, address `https://ascii.fedekotek.design#components/tooltip`
- Group: Overlay
- In the kit: yes, `kit/starter.html#tooltip`
- Caption: A short hint for a control, on hover, focus or tap. It types itself in.
- Behaviors:
  - `data-aui="tooltip"`: a tap shows it, Escape puts it away
- CSS blocks:
  - `button`: `.btn`
  - `dropdown`: `.pop .menu`
  - `tooltip`: `.tip`
- Use it for:
  - A short hint on a control whose label is not the whole story: what "Ship it" does, and when.
  - The name of a button that shows only a glyph, next to its `aria-label`.
- Not for:
  - Anything a person needs to finish the task. Put it on the page, near the field.
  - Links or buttons. Nothing in a tooltip can be clicked.
  - Errors. That is the message under an [Input](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/input).

Anatomy:

```text
1  Deploys on a Friday
2   v
  =============
3 :: SHIP IT ::
  =============
```

1. **tip** `.tip`: `role="tooltip"`: an ink slab above the trigger, one line. It types itself in from the left.
2. **arrow** `.tip`: A v under it, paint. On a touch screen the tip shows below and the arrow is ^.
3. **trigger** `button`: A [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), a link, an input, or anything with `tabindex`. The kit points its `aria-describedby` at the tip.

| State | Looks like | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| hidden | ` ` | Clipped to nothing. It is on the page, not drawn. |
| hover | ` Deploys` | The pointer on the trigger: it types in, in 8 steps. |
| focus | ` Deploys` | The trigger has the focus: the same. |
| on, after a tap | ` Deploys` | `.on`: shown below the trigger for 1.8 seconds. |
| off, after Escape | ` ` | `.off`: put away until the pointer or the focus comes back. |
| no script | ` Deploys` | Hover and focus still show it. That part is CSS. No tap, no Escape. |

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Focus on the trigger shows it. |
| `Esc` | Puts it away and leaves the focus where it is. |

Accessibility:
- **role**: `role="tooltip"` on the tip.
- **name**: It describes, it does not name. The kit sets `aria-describedby` on the trigger, so the tip is read after the label.
- **focus**: Nothing in it takes the focus. It cannot hold a link or a button.
- **touch**: Hover and focus do nothing on a touch screen. A tap shows it below, where the finger is not, for 1.8 seconds.
- **paint**: The arrow is CSS content with empty alt text.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Keep it to one line, read at a glance. | Write a paragraph. It does not wrap on a desktop and runs off the screen. |
| Put it on something that takes the focus: a button, a link. | Put it on plain text, where a keyboard never reaches it. |

| Kind | Name | Does |
|---|---|---|
| attr | `data-aui="tooltip"` | On the `.pop`. Adds the tap and Escape. Hover and focus are CSS. |
| class | `.pop .tip` | The box around trigger and tip, and the tip. |
| class | `.on .off` | Set by the kit: shown after a tap, put away after Escape. |
| call | `ASCIIUI.get(el)` | `show()` for 1.8 seconds, `hide()` until the pointer or the focus comes back. |

See also: [Button](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/button), [Kbd](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/kbd), [Dropdown](https://ascii.fedekotek.design/#components/dropdown)

Limits:
- Always above the trigger, from its left edge, on a desktop. It does not flip near the top of the screen.
- One line on a desktop. It wraps only on touch.

```html
<div class="pop" data-aui="tooltip">
  <button class="btn frame tone-light" type="button"><span class="mid"><span class="label">Ship it</span></span></button>
  <span class="tip" role="tooltip">Deploys to production on a Friday</span>
</div>
```
